subject: Migration windows, ops asks and doc ownership - alignment needed
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Migration windows, ops asks and doc ownership - alignment needed

Team —

We have an ask from Atlas that affects our June->July ramp: they need us to avoid their nightly backups (02:00-03:30 local) for a three-day migration window if they opt into the dedicated routing. They also flagged a compliance checklist item that requires us to expose audit-log retention details before final sign-off.

Quick requests:
- Can Platform confirm whether we can support a constrained window (01:00-02:00 PDT) for staged traffic shifts and if that will change our rollout automation? (Ben)
- Product enablement: who will own the Atlas-facing runbook and the internal playbook updates? I propose Marissa owns external-facing runbook, Grace owns internal ops runbook. If you disagree, speak up.
- Legal/security: I looped Atlas but they want the audit-retention snippet in writing. Lauren — can you provide a one-paragraph statement we can share by EOD?

I'm attaching the current schedule (v1) and the enablement checklist. Please reply with clear yes/no or a short note — need to finalize the migration window by 5pm PT so Atlas can schedule their DB migration.

Michael
Michael Grant
Senior PM, Launch and Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: release_schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), enablement_checklist_v3.docx (doc)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Migration windows, ops asks and doc ownership - alignment needed

Michael / all —

Short answer: we can support a constrained window but with conditions. The runtime autoscaler and draining logic currently assume 02:00-04:00 maintenance windows for a lot of our infra scripts; shifting to 01:00-02:00 we can do, but we need to:

- Freeze any large batch rebuilds 24h prior (I flagged these in the attached CSV)
- Add a one-off pre-warm run 3 hours before the shift to avoid cold-KV spikes
- Accept a small increase in tail latency for the first 30 minutes as caches rehydrate

I can implement the autoscaler tweak and the pre-warm but will need a half-day ops sprint (I estimate 4 hours) and a runbook update. If Atlas can accept a 01:30-02:30 window instead, that gives us slightly better overlap with low-traffic hours across regions.

Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Engineering Manager

Attachment referenced: migration_blackout_matrix.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Migration windows, ops asks and doc ownership - alignment needed

Thanks —

I accept ownership of the Atlas-facing runbook. I'll produce:
- A short runbook (one page) covering migration flow, rollback criteria, primary/secondary contacts, and the audit-retention statement.
- A slide for enablement that CS can use for the post-migration check-in.

Target: draft runbook by 3pm PT, final by EOD after Lauren's security blurb. Grace, can you confirm the ops runbook callouts Ben needs? I can fold in any acceptance criteria you give me.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Migration windows, ops asks and doc ownership - alignment needed

Hi all —

One-paragraph audit-retention statement below (please do not change wording to avoid legal drift):

"Redwood Inference retains audit logs related to account-level inference requests and system events for a period of 365 days by default. Customers requiring a different retention period can request an alternative configuration through their account manager; any deviation is recorded and subject to our data access and export controls. Logs are stored in encrypted storage with access logged and restricted to authorized personnel only."

Marissa — that's good to paste into the external runbook. Ben — two small asks from security: add the retention location (us-east-1 encrypted bucket) and confirm rotation/key-management (we use KMS with 90-day rotation policy); if that's accurate, I'm good.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
